key_entities: multiple updates for ref not allowed
propositions: Multiple bundles for one S3 ref cause clone failure with 'multiple updates for ref not allowed' and push stall at git-remote-s3's cmd_push rejection, making the store unclonable and unwritable
Upstream's interactive Doctor.fix_multiple_bundles is unusable for autonomous fleets (blocks on input() at EOF) and discards non-chosen heads, losing unique ticket events from the append-only store

The multi-bundle state is ordinary ref divergence hidden at the bundle-storage layer, reducible to rebar's already-solved git lossless-merge case (sync._union_merge with lossless 2-parent merges, never discarding)

The heal must write the merged tip as a new bundle before deleting any original bundle and never delete the merged tip, guaranteeing at least one bundle carrying full merged history survives every crash point

Concurrent repairs must serialize via the helper's per-ref S3 lock; a process that cannot acquire the lock backs off without healing and converges when the lock-holder collapses the remote to a single bundle

The doctor folds N divergent heads via iterated 2-parent merges (not octopus) following sync's lossless semantics, aborting only on genuine content conflicts in non-derived files and surfacing fsck-recover, never silently discarding a parent
